title: Canada Goose to Announce Third Quarter Fiscal Year 2026 Financial Results on February 5, 2026
summary: Canada Goose Holdings Inc. (NYSE, TSX: GOOS) plans to announce results for the third quarter of fiscal year 2026, which ended December 28, 2025, before markets open on Thursday, February 5, 2026. The Company will host a conference call and webcast to discuss third quarter fiscal 2026 results at 8:30am ET on Thursday, February 5, 2026. A live webcast of the conference call will be available on the company’s website at http://investor.canadagoose.com . The conference call can be accessed by using the following link: Canada Goose Q3 2026 Earnings Call . After registering, an email including the conference call link will be sent to join the live call. An archived replay of the webcast will be available shortly after the conclusion of the call.
